高級大人對帳：延遲享受談完了，現在每個月都有結餘——這才是真的不窮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是用「投資自己」當藉口刷卡的朋友
variations: 不是買不起，是這個月的額度已經拿去買清醒了。

en.content:
Junior adult checking the balance: 'I'm not broke, I'm in a committed relationship with delayed gratification.'

Senior adult checking the balance: the delayed gratification paid off, and now there's something left over every month — that's what not broke actually looks like.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who justifies every purchase as 'investing in myself'
variations: It's not that I can't afford it — this month's budget already went toward staying sane.

items.sourceNote: 'adult money goes to unglamorous maintenance costs' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人以為長大後的錢，是拿去旅行、買名牌、過爽日子。

高級大人才發現，大人的錢大多默默流向：修車、補牙、換濾網、再買一次衛生紙，全是沒人會幫你按讚的支出。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個發現薪水都拿去維修人生、根本沒空享受人生的朋友
variations: 成年人的奢侈品，是水電帳單繳完還剩一點點的安心感。

en.content:
Junior adult thinks grown-up money goes to travel, nice brands, and the good life.

Senior adult finds out adult money mostly drains quietly into car repairs, dental work, replacing the filter, and buying toilet paper again — all the costs nobody will ever like a photo of.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who realized their paycheck goes to maintaining life, not actually enjoying it
variations: An adult's idea of luxury is having a little left over after the utility bill clears.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 returns home and reverts to child; Threads 2026 trend; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人在公司：帶團隊、扛專案、開會殺氣騰騰。

初級大人一回家：「媽，我的襪子放哪？」瞬間退化回三歲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在外面獨當一面、回家立刻變回媽寶的朋友（包含你自己）
variations: 在外面是專案負責人，在家是連水果都要等人切好的小孩。

en.content:
Junior adult at the office: leads the team, carries the project, walks into meetings like a force of nature.

Junior adult the moment they get home: 'Mom, where are my socks?' Instantly reverts to age three.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who runs the show at work and turns back into a helpless kid the second they walk through the front door (yourself included)
variations: Out in the world I'm the project lead; at home I'm the kid waiting for someone to slice the fruit for me.

items.sourceNote: 'adulting is just Googling' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人：遇到不會的事，先偷偷 Google，然後假裝一臉本來就會的樣子。

高級大人：遇到不會的事，直接說「這我不懂」，然後找對的人問——原來承認不會，才是真正的會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是邊查邊裝懂、其實緊張到手心冒汗的朋友
variations: 成年人的專業，有一半是 Google 撐起來的，另一半是裝鎮定。

en.content:
Junior adult: hits something they don't know, secretly Googles it, then acts like they knew all along.

Senior adult: hits something they don't know, just says 'no idea, not my area,' and asks the right person — turns out admitting you don't know is the real skill.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who Googles everything mid-conversation while sweating and pretending it's all under control
variations: Half of being a competent adult is Google; the other half is keeping a straight face.

items.sourceNote: 'let me check my calendar means no' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人想拒絕邀約：支支吾吾找一堆理由，最後還是答應了。

高級大人想拒絕邀約：「我看一下行程喔」——大家都懂，這句話的意思就是不要。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠不會拒絕、最後行程塞爆又後悔的朋友
variations: 大人最強的防身術，就是淡淡一句「我再看看時間」。

en.content:
Junior adult turning down an invite: stammers through a pile of excuses and ends up saying yes anyway.

Senior adult turning down an invite: 'Let me check my calendar' — and everyone knows that phrase just means no.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who can't say no and ends up with a packed schedule full of regret
variations: An adult's most powerful self-defense move is a calm 'let me see if I'm free.'

items.sourceNote: 'being tired is now a personality trait' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人：累了就喊累，覺得睡一覺隔天就會滿血復活。

高級大人：早就不喊累了，因為「累」已經不是一種狀態，是一種體質——醒著的時候都累。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個睡再多還是累、把疲憊活成個性的朋友
variations: 長大以後才懂，最奢侈的不是有錢，是有那種一覺醒來真的有精神的早晨。

en.content:
Junior adult: complains when they're tired, sure that one good night's sleep will fully recharge them by morning.

Senior adult: stopped complaining long ago, because 'tired' isn't a state anymore — it's a constitution. Awake equals tired.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who sleeps plenty and is still exhausted, the one who's made being tired a personality
variations: Growing up taught me the real luxury isn't money — it's a morning where you actually wake up feeling rested.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 doesn't know rice cooker inner pot needs water / asks high-level adult for everyday judgment; Threads 2026 trend; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人煮火鍋：每丟一樣料都要問「這個熟了沒？可以吃了嗎？」

高級大人煮火鍋：默默把生的撈回去，順便決定今晚誰可以先吃——原來「熟了沒」這種事，也是要有人拍板的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個聚餐時負責問「這可以吃了嗎」、但從來不敢自己決定的朋友
variations: 在家最高權力，是那個敢說「這個還不能吃」的人。

en.content:
Junior adult at hotpot: asks 'Is this cooked yet? Can I eat it?' for literally every single thing they drop in.

Senior adult at hotpot: quietly fishes the raw stuff back out and decides who gets to eat first — turns out even 'is it cooked' is a call somebody has to make.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who's always the one asking 'can I eat this yet' but never dares to make the call themselves
variations: The highest authority at the dinner table is whoever can confidently say 'that's not done yet.'

items.sourceNote: 'adulting is just googling everything' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人遇到問題：先 Google，看別人怎麼說。

高級大人遇到問題：也是先 Google，只是 Google 完發現答案全是別的高級大人在問同一題——原來大家都在裝懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個什麼都要先查一下、查完還是半信半疑的朋友
variations: 長大就是發現，所謂的大人其實只是 Google 速度比較快的小孩。

en.content:
Junior adult hits a problem: googles it to see what other people say.

Senior adult hits a problem: also googles it, then realizes every answer is just other senior adults asking the exact same question — turns out we're all winging it.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who googles everything and still ends up unsure
variations: Growing up is realizing an adult is just a kid who googles faster.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 reverts to child at home / asks parents for everyday decisions; Threads 2026 trend; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人在公司：開會、扛專案、帶新人，樣樣行。

初級大人回到家：媽，這個水果可以吃了嗎？冰箱那罐是不是壞了？——在爸媽面前，我的年資自動歸零。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在外面是主管、回家秒變三歲的朋友，他一定懂
variations: 回到家最神奇的事，就是再厲害的工作能力都會自動斷線。

en.content:
Junior adult at the office: runs meetings, carries projects, trains the new hires. Total pro.

Junior adult back home: 'Mom, can I eat this fruit? Is that jar in the fridge still good?' — in front of your parents, your years of experience reset to zero.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who's a manager at work and turns three years old the second they get home
variations: The wildest part of going home is watching all your competence quietly log off.

items.sourceNote: 'pretending to have life together' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人：覺得別人的人生都很穩，只有自己一團亂。

高級大人：知道大家其實都一團亂，只是把亂的部分藏在好看的限動後面而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得自己過得比別人狼狽的朋友，提醒他大家都在演
variations: 所謂成熟，就是學會在崩潰邊緣，還能把限動拍得很歲月靜好。

en.content:
Junior adult: thinks everyone else has it together and they're the only mess.

Senior adult: knows everyone's a mess too, they just keep the mess tucked behind a really nice story.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who's sure they're more of a disaster than everyone else — spoiler, we're all faking it
variations: Maturity is being one breath from a meltdown and still posting a story that looks serene.

items.sourceNote: 'I need a nap but never take one' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人累了：說「我要睡了」，然後真的去睡。

高級大人累了：說「我要睡了」，然後滑手機到三點——嘴上喊著想休息，身體卻在報復性熬夜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每天喊著要早睡、卻總是熬到半夜的朋友
variations: 長大後最大的謊言，就是每天晚上對自己說的那句「今天一定早睡」。

en.content:
Junior adult gets tired: says 'I'm going to bed,' then actually goes to bed.

Senior adult gets tired: says 'I'm going to bed,' then scrolls until 3 a.m. — claims they want rest while their body stages a revenge bedtime.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who swears they'll sleep early every night and never does
variations: The biggest lie of adulthood is the 'I'll definitely sleep early tonight' you tell yourself every single night.

items.sourceNote: 'just got paid, $4.72 in account' money humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人發薪日：「我有錢了！」然後一個週末就花到只剩零頭。

高級大人發薪日：薪水進帳那秒，房租、保險、定期定額自動扣完，剩下的才敢叫做自己的錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次月初像富翁、月底吃泡麵的朋友
variations: 所謂長大，就是發薪日的快樂只有薪水入帳到自動扣款之間那三秒。

en.content:
Junior adult on payday: 'I'm rich!' — then blows it all by Sunday and stares at the leftover change.

Senior adult on payday: the second the paycheck lands, rent, insurance, and auto-invest sweep it away. Whatever survives is the only part they dare call their own.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who's a millionaire on the 1st and eating instant noodles by the 28th
variations: Growing up is realizing payday joy only lasts the three seconds between the deposit and the automatic withdrawals.

items.sourceNote: 'budgeting style: guess and regret' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人記帳：靠感覺，「應該還夠吧」。

高級大人記帳：也靠感覺，只是那個感覺後來被命名為「猜一下，然後後悔」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個下載了三個記帳 App、一個都沒打開的朋友
variations: 我的理財原則就是：先花再算，算完發現算了也沒用。

en.content:
Junior adult budgets: by vibes — 'should be enough, probably.'

Senior adult budgets: also by vibes — they just later gave that vibe an official name: 'Guess, Then Regret.'
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who downloaded three budgeting apps and opened exactly zero
variations: My financial strategy is spend first, do the math later, then realize the math changes nothing.

items.sourceNote: 'wore pants, that's the achievement' adulting humor; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的好日子：要把所有待辦事項都打勾，才算沒白活。

高級大人的好日子：今天有穿褲子、有出門、有把那杯放到發酸的咖啡倒掉——已經是當週成就解鎖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個對自己要求超高、結果天天覺得自己一事無成的朋友
variations: 長大後的成就感門檻越降越低，低到今天有準時起床就想給自己頒獎。

en.content:
Junior adult's good day: every single to-do has to be checked off, or the day doesn't count.

Senior adult's good day: wore pants, left the house, and finally poured out that coffee that went sour three days ago — achievement of the week, unlocked.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who sets impossibly high standards and then feels like a failure every single day
variations: The bar for feeling accomplished keeps dropping until 'woke up on time' deserves a trophy.

items.sourceNote: 'delegated chores to future me' responsibility-avoidance theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人面對麻煩事：先擱著，「等我有空再說」。

高級大人面對麻煩事：一樣先擱著，只是會體貼地把它打包好，交給一個叫「未來的我」的可憐人去處理。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是把問題留給明天、然後明天又留給後天的拖延同好
variations: 我沒有逃避責任，我只是把責任外包給了一個沒辦法拒絕我的人——未來的我。

en.content:
Junior adult faces an annoying task: shelves it — 'I'll deal with it when I have time.'

Senior adult faces an annoying task: also shelves it, but thoughtfully wraps it up and hands it to a poor soul named Future Me.
en.editorNote: Tag the procrastination buddy who leaves everything for tomorrow, then leaves tomorrow for the day after
variations: I didn't dodge my responsibilities — I just outsourced them to the one person who can't say no to me: future me.

items.sourceNote: 'I can't, I have bills' adult-sentence theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人拒絕邀約：要編一個聽起來很體面的理由，怕被說掃興。

高級大人拒絕邀約：直接說「不行，這個月要繳的東西比較多」——這句話現在比任何理由都有說服力。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個學會用「最近比較緊」優雅婉拒所有花錢局的朋友
variations: 長大後最有底氣的一句話，不是「我很忙」，而是「我這個月預算用完了」。

en.content:
Junior adult turns down an invite: invents a respectable-sounding excuse, terrified of being called a buzzkill.

Senior adult turns down an invite: just says 'Can't, got a lot of bills this month' — and somehow that's more convincing than any excuse ever was.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who's mastered declining every expensive plan with a graceful 'money's a bit tight right now'
variations: The most powerful sentence in adulthood isn't 'I'm busy' — it's 'I'm out of budget this month.'

items.sourceNote: 'adulting is googling how to do things' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人遇到不會的事：偷偷 Google，假裝自己本來就知道，深怕被發現是個冒牌大人。

高級大人遇到不會的事：大方說「我查一下」，然後當著大家的面 Google——反正所有大人都是這樣活下來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個邊修水龍頭邊開著 YouTube 教學的朋友，告訴他這就是真正的大人
variations: 所謂長大，就是一邊裝得很懂，一邊在搜尋欄打「這個正常嗎」。

en.content:
Junior adult hits something they don't know how to do: secretly Googles it, pretends they knew all along, terrified of being exposed as a fraud adult.

Senior adult hits something they don't know: cheerfully says 'let me look that up' and Googles it right in front of everyone — because that's how all of us are surviving anyway.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend fixing the faucet with a YouTube tutorial open — that IS being a real adult
variations: Growing up is just acting like you've got it together while typing 'is this normal' into the search bar.

items.sourceNote: 'being tired is now a personality trait' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人被問近況：努力想一件聽起來很精彩的事來回答。

高級大人被問近況：直接說「累」，然後對方也說「累」，兩個人就這樣達成了深刻的共鳴。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把「好累」當成口頭禪、見面第一句永遠是這個的朋友
variations: 長大後最真誠的問候，是兩個人互相確認對方一樣累。

en.content:
Junior adult gets asked how they're doing: scrambles to come up with something impressive to say.

Senior adult gets asked how they're doing: just says 'tired,' the other person says 'tired' too, and the two of them reach a profound mutual understanding.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend whose catchphrase is 'so tired' and whose first words at every meetup are exactly that
variations: The most sincere greeting in adulthood is two people confirming they're equally exhausted.

items.sourceNote: 'groceries cost more than my childhood dreams' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人逛超市：看到喜歡的就丟進推車，結帳時被總金額嚇一跳。

高級大人逛超市：站在貨架前算單價、比特價、看保存期限，結帳時還是被嚇一跳——只是這次心裡有數。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個現在進超市像在做數學題、為了幾塊錢猶豫很久的朋友
variations: 小時候的夢想很貴，長大後發現一車菜更貴。

en.content:
Junior adult at the grocery store: tosses whatever looks good into the cart, gets ambushed by the total at checkout.

Senior adult at the grocery store: stands in the aisle calculating unit prices, comparing deals, checking expiry dates — and still gets ambushed at checkout, just with full awareness this time.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who now treats grocery runs like a math exam and agonizes over a few bucks
variations: Childhood dreams were expensive — turns out a full cart of groceries costs more.

items.sourceNote: 'doing taxes and only crying twice' / school never taught taxes theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人報稅：打開表格，腦袋一片空白，邊填邊懷疑當年數學課到底在教什麼。

高級大人報稅：一樣腦袋空白，但已經學會把這件事當成每年一次的成年禮——哭兩次就過去了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每到報稅季就在群組裡哀號、然後互相安慰的朋友
variations: 學校教了我一堆公式，卻沒教我怎麼報稅——而報稅才是真正會考的那一科。

en.content:
Junior adult does their taxes: opens the form, mind goes blank, starts questioning what math class was even for.

Senior adult does their taxes: mind still goes blank, but they've learned to treat it as a once-a-year rite of passage — you cry twice and it's over.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who wails in the group chat every tax season so you can all comfort each other
variations: School taught me a hundred formulas but never how to file taxes — and taxes are the one thing that's actually on the test.

items.sourceNote: 'nobody knows what they're doing, the good ones Googled it' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
長大以後才發現一個天大的祕密：其實沒有人知道自己在幹嘛。
看起來很罩的那些人，只是先偷偷上網查過而已。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得別人都比自己會當大人、其實大家都在硬撐的朋友
variations: 成年人的標準配備不是駕照，是一個半夜偷偷搜尋「這個正常嗎」的瀏覽器分頁。
所謂大人，就是一邊假裝鎮定，一邊在廁所偷偷查「這個流程到底怎麼跑」的人。

en.content:
The biggest secret of adulthood: nobody actually knows what they're doing.
The ones who look like they've got it together just Googled it first.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who thinks everyone else has adulthood figured out — spoiler: we're all winging it
variations: Standard-issue adult equipment isn't a driver's license, it's a browser tab that quietly searches 'is this normal' at 2 AM.
An adult is just someone keeping a straight face in the meeting while secretly Googling the answer under the table.

items.sourceNote: 'money comes in quietly and leaves dramatically' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
薪水進帳的時候安安靜靜，連個聲音都沒有。
離開的時候卻轟轟烈烈，房租、帳單、保險一個一個排隊跟你說再見。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次發薪日只開心三秒就要還各種帳單的同事，月底必轉
variations: 我的錢跟我的關係：來的時候像偷偷溜進來，走的時候像辦了一場盛大的歡送會。

en.content:
Money arrives quietly — not even a notification ding.
Then it leaves dramatically: rent, bills, and insurance all line up to wave goodbye.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker whose payday joy lasts exactly three seconds before the bills hit — peak end-of-month energy
variations: My relationship with money: it sneaks in through the back door and leaves with a full farewell parade.

items.sourceNote: 'being tired is now a personality trait' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人累：累了會抱怨，覺得睡一覺就會好。

高級大人累：已經把「累」當成個性的一部分，跟人見面第一句就是「最近也是很累」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個見面打招呼從「吃飽沒」變成「累不累」的朋友
variations: 當大人最划算的地方：你不用培養興趣，因為「累」已經是一種人格特質了。

en.content:
Junior adult tired: complains about it and assumes one good night's sleep will fix everything.

Senior adult tired: has accepted 'tired' as a core personality trait, opening every conversation with 'yeah, exhausted as usual.'
en.editorNote: Send to the friend whose default greeting evolved from 'how are you' to 'so tired, you?'
variations: The most efficient thing about adulthood: you don't need a hobby, because being tired already counts as a personality.

items.sourceNote: 'choosing which bill to panic over first' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人理財：帳單來了就慌，每一張都想立刻繳清。

高級大人理財：帳單來了一樣慌，但已經練就一身排序的本事——先決定這個月要為哪一張先煩惱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個月初就在排「哪張帳單先繳」順序、把焦慮分期付款的朋友
variations: 成年人的真正技能不是賺錢，是學會挑選這個月要先為哪一筆開銷失眠。

en.content:
Junior adult budgeting: a bill arrives and panic sets in, wanting to pay every one immediately.

Senior adult budgeting: still panics, but has mastered the art of triage — calmly deciding which bill to stress about first this month.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who ranks their bills by panic level and pays anxiety in installments
variations: The real adult skill isn't making money, it's choosing which expense gets to keep you up at night this month.

items.sourceNote: 'cleaning things then watching them get dirty again' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大就能想多髒就多髒，沒人管。
沒想到當大人最大的工作，就是把東西打掃乾淨，然後看著它再髒一次——無限循環，沒有終點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個剛拖完地、孩子或室友五分鐘後就把它弄髒的人，家事永動機認證
variations: 成年人的日常就是一場跟灰塵的拉鋸戰，而灰塵從來不需要休假。

en.content:
As a kid you thought growing up meant being as messy as you wanted, with nobody to nag you.
Turns out the main job of adulthood is cleaning things spotless, then watching them get dirty all over again — an infinite loop with no finish line.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who just mopped the floor right before a kid or roommate destroyed it in five minutes — certified housework perpetual motion
variations: Adult life is just an endless tug-of-war with dust, and dust never takes a day off.

items.sourceNote: Threads 初級大人 trend: '在爸媽面前我只有三歲' family-regression theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
在外面我是會議裡發號施令、簽核預算的高級大人，
回到爸媽家，我立刻降級成那個被叫去拿碗筷、坐在小孩桌、買水果還要先問一句「這個熟了沒」的三歲小孩。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在公司獨當一面、回老家卻秒變小屁孩的朋友，過年群組必轉
variations: 成年人的雙重身份：在公司是部門主管，在媽媽眼裡是連洗米水量都會放錯的那個孩子。

en.content:
Out in the world I'm a senior adult who runs meetings and signs off on budgets.
Back at my parents' place I instantly get demoted to the three-year-old who gets sent to fetch the chopsticks, sits at the kids' table, and has to ask 'is this one ripe?' before buying fruit.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who leads a whole department at work but turns back into a little kid the second they walk into their parents' house
variations: Adult double life: department head at the office, the kid who still measures rice water wrong in mom's eyes.

items.sourceNote: 'exhausted at 9PM, wide awake at 3AM replaying awkward moments' adulting quote; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
成年人的睡眠很神奇：
晚上九點累到眼睛睜不開，半夜三點卻精神得很——剛好可以重播二〇一三年那句講錯話的尷尬瞬間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個白天哈欠連連、一躺平就開始反省人生的失眠戰友
variations: 我的大腦營業時間：白天罷工，凌晨三點準時開機回放黑歷史。

en.content:
Adult sleep is a magical thing:
at 9 PM you can barely keep your eyes open, but at 3 AM you're wide awake — just in time to replay that awkward thing you said back in 2013.
en.editorNote: Send to the insomnia buddy who yawns all day and starts re-litigating their entire life the moment they lie down
variations: My brain's business hours: closed all day, opens promptly at 3 AM to screen my greatest hits of embarrassment.

items.sourceNote: decision fatigue / 35,000 decisions a day adult-truth theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大就是想做什麼都自己決定，超自由。
沒想到當大人最累的不是工作，是從早到晚要做的那三萬個決定——光是「晚餐吃什麼」就能耗掉我最後一格電。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個下班後連「要不要喝水」都決定不了的決策疲勞重症患者
variations: 成年人的自由是：所有事都能自己決定，代價是所有事都得自己決定。

en.content:
As a kid you thought growing up meant deciding everything for yourself — total freedom.
Turns out the most exhausting part of being an adult isn't the work, it's the thousands of decisions you make all day. 'What's for dinner' alone drains my last bar of battery.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend with such bad decision fatigue they can't even decide whether to drink water after work
variations: Adult freedom: you get to decide everything, and the price is that you have to decide everything.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 self-test format: still calling a 'senior adult' for grown-up tasks; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
怎麼判斷自己還是初級大人？
看到「房屋稅」「健保補繳」「報帳核銷」這幾個字，第一個念頭不是怎麼處理，而是「我可以打給誰請他幫我看一下」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個帳單一來就想找爸媽或那位萬能朋友求救的初級大人，附上一句「我也是」
variations: 初級大人的求生本能：遇到看不懂的公文，先截圖傳到家庭群組，標註那位什麼都會的高級大人。

en.content:
How do you know you're still a junior adult?
When you see words like 'property tax,' 'insurance back-payment,' or 'expense reimbursement,' your first thought isn't how to handle it — it's 'who can I call to look at this for me?'
en.editorNote: Send to the junior adult who immediately calls their parents or that one capable friend the moment a bill shows up, with a 'same here'
variations: Junior adult survival instinct: see a confusing official letter, screenshot it, and tag the senior adult in the family group chat who knows everything.

items.sourceNote: financial-independence reality / 'thought adulthood meant making lots of money' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大就會很有錢，想買什麼買什麼。
長大後才發現：錢是有進來，但它只是路過——從薪轉戶口短暫停留，就被房租、帳單、保費接力帶走，連說聲再見的時間都沒有。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每月發薪日當天就已經知道這筆錢要去哪的月光族戰友
variations: 我的薪水跟我的緣分很淺，每個月見一次面，當天就分手。

en.content:
As a kid you thought growing up meant being rich enough to buy whatever you wanted.
Grown up, you learn the money does come in — it's just passing through. It makes a brief stop in your account before rent, bills, and insurance tag-team it away, no time even to say goodbye.
en.editorNote: Send to the paycheck-to-paycheck buddy who already knows exactly where every dollar is going the moment payday hits
variations: My paycheck and I aren't close — we meet once a month and break up the same day.

items.sourceNote: 'adult friendship is texting I miss you and both agreeing doing nothing about it is fine' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content: 大人的友情：互傳「好久不見，超想你，下次一定要約」，然後兩個人都很有默契地——沒有下次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你約了半年都還沒見面、但感情依然很好的好朋友
variations: 成年人的「改天一起吃飯」是一種祝福語，不是行程。

en.content: Adult friendship: texting each other 'miss you, we HAVE to hang out soon,' and then both quietly agreeing that doing absolutely nothing about it is totally fine.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend you've been meaning to see for six months and still somehow love
variations: 'Let's grab dinner sometime' is a blessing adults give each other, not an actual plan.

items.sourceNote: 'adult life is cleaning things and then watching them get dirty again' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大就是自由。
長大後才發現，自由就是：你終於可以隨時打掃，然後親眼看著它在三天內又變回原樣，無限循環。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個剛拖完地、轉頭就看到貓踩出腳印的同住戰友
variations: 當大人最累的不是工作，是你才剛收好的房間，宇宙好像有一股力量要把它弄亂。

en.content:
As a kid you thought being grown up meant freedom.
Turns out freedom is: you're finally allowed to clean whenever you want, then watch it get messy again within three days, on an endless loop.
en.editorNote: Send to the roommate who just mopped the floor and immediately spotted fresh footprints
variations: The exhausting part of adulthood isn't the job — it's that the room you just tidied seems to attract chaos like a magnet.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 contrast format, 'beginner adult panics over bills' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人收到帳單：先放著，假裝沒看到，期限前一天才崩潰。

高級大人收到帳單：開 App，三秒繳完，順便看一下這個月哪裡可以省。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個帳單永遠堆到最後一天才處理的拖延型室友
variations: 初級大人理財：戶頭裡的數字是個謎。高級大人理財：每一塊錢都被分配好工作了。

en.content:
Beginner adult gets a bill: leaves it on the table, pretends not to see it, then panics the night before it's due.

Senior adult gets a bill: opens the app, pays it in three seconds, and checks where they can cut back this month.
en.editorNote: Tag the roommate who lets every bill pile up until the very last day
variations: Beginner adult budgeting: the number in the account is a mystery. Senior adult budgeting: every dollar already has a job assigned.

items.sourceNote: 'adulting is Googling how to do things' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
以為長大後就會什麼都懂，結果現在的我，只是一個很會用搜尋引擎的成年人。

每件事都是邊查邊做，然後祈禱沒人發現我其實不知道自己在幹嘛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 配一張深夜對著螢幕查「這個表格怎麼填」的自己，發限動保證有人回「我也是」
variations: 長大不是變得什麼都會，是變得很會裝作自己會，然後偷偷去查。

en.content:
I thought being a grown-up meant knowing things. Turns out I'm just an adult who's really good at using a search engine.

I figure everything out as I go and pray nobody notices I have no idea what I'm doing.
en.editorNote: Pair with a late-night shot of yourself Googling 'how do I fill out this form' — someone will reply 'same'
variations: Growing up isn't knowing how to do things. It's learning to look like you do, then quietly Googling it.

items.sourceNote: 'being tired is a personality trait' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大會很自由，現在唯一的自由，是可以選擇要累著坐、還是累著躺。

我不是懶，我只是把「累」升級成了一種人格特質。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個週末唯一計畫就是「什麼都不做」的同類，互相取暖
variations: 大人的興趣：躺著。專長：也是躺著。夢想：躺久一點。

en.content:
As a kid I thought being grown up meant freedom. Turns out my only freedom is choosing whether to be tired sitting down or tired lying down.

I'm not lazy — I've just upgraded 'tired' into a full personality trait.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend whose entire weekend plan is 'nothing' — solidarity
variations: Adult hobby: lying down. Special skill: also lying down. Dream: lying down for longer.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 '會挑水果／逛市場' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人買水果：站在攤子前不知道怎麼挑，最後隨便抓一顆，回家發現是酸的。

高級大人買水果：聞一下、按一下、問老闆哪個甜，還順便殺個價。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個去菜市場像進迷宮、只敢買超市包好的那種朋友
variations: 初級大人逛市場：全程不敢跟老闆講話。高級大人逛市場：跟老闆聊到變熟客，最後多送一把蔥。

en.content:
Beginner adult buying fruit: stands at the stall with no idea how to pick, grabs one at random, gets home and it's sour.

Senior adult buying fruit: smells it, gives it a squeeze, asks the vendor which is sweetest, and haggles a little on the way out.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who treats the farmers market like a maze and only buys the pre-packed supermarket stuff
variations: Beginner adult at the market: too shy to talk to any vendor. Senior adult: chats them up until they're a regular and gets a free bunch of scallions.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 '打電話處理事情' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人要打電話問事情：先在腦中演練台詞五分鐘，撥號前深呼吸，講到一半就緊張到忘記要問什麼。

高級大人要打電話：一邊講一邊做別的事，還能順手把對方沒說到的重點問完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個寧願排隊也不想打客服電話的社恐朋友，他會秒懂
variations: 初級大人接到陌生來電：直接讓它響完，再上網查號碼。高級大人：接起來三句話解決。

en.content:
Beginner adult has to make a phone call: rehearses the lines in their head for five minutes, takes a deep breath before dialing, then freezes halfway and forgets what they were asking.

Senior adult makes a call: does three other things at the same time and still covers every point the other person forgot to mention.
en.editorNote: Tag the socially anxious friend who'd rather wait in line than call customer service — instant recognition
variations: Beginner adult gets an unknown call: lets it ring out, then Googles the number. Senior adult: picks up and sorts it in three sentences.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 '看醫生' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人看醫生：進診間忘記自己哪裡不舒服，醫生問什麼都回「還好」，出來才想起本來要問的問題。

高級大人看醫生：把症狀從哪天開始、痛幾分、吃過什麼藥講得清清楚楚，順便把家人的份也問完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次看完醫生走出來才開始後悔忘了問的朋友
variations: 初級大人拿到藥：完全不敢問怎麼吃，回家再上網查。高級大人：當場把飯前飯後、會不會想睡問到懂。

en.content:
Beginner adult at the doctor: forgets what's actually wrong the second they sit down, answers 'it's fine' to everything, and only remembers their real question on the way out.

Senior adult at the doctor: lays out exactly when it started, how bad the pain is, and what they've already tried — then asks about the whole family too.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who only remembers the important question after leaving the clinic
variations: Beginner adult gets a prescription: too shy to ask how to take it, Googles it at home. Senior adult: nails down before-or-after meals and drowsiness right there.

items.sourceNote: adulting one-liner 'rent/money' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
薪水這種東西，進來的時候安安靜靜，
出去的時候鑼鼓喧天、鞭炮齊鳴。
zh-tw.editorNote: 發薪日隔天傳給同事，一起看著帳戶數字流淚
variations: 房租從我身上拿走的，比任何一段感情都多。

en.content:
My paycheck arrives quietly, like it's sneaking in.
Then it leaves with fireworks, a marching band, and zero notice.
en.editorNote: Send this to a coworker the day after payday and watch your balances together
variations: Rent has taken more out of me than any relationship ever did.

items.sourceNote: adulting one-liner 'making friends as an adult' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
長大後交朋友，就是兩個人連續半年互相說「改天約」，
然後那個改天永遠沒有到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你們已經說要約吃飯說了一整年的朋友
variations: 成年人的友情：已讀不是不理你，是真的太累了，但我心裡有你。

en.content:
Making friends as an adult is just two people saying 'we should totally hang out'
for six straight months and never once doing it.
en.editorNote: Send this to the friend you've been meaning to grab dinner with for a year now
variations: Adult friendship: leaving you on read isn't ignoring you — it's just exhaustion, but I promise you're in my heart.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 '處理文件' angle; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人收到一封公文：光看標題就頭皮發麻，先放著，假裝沒看到，希望它自己消失。

高級大人收到公文：三分鐘看完重點，該回的回、該轉的轉，然後把死線設進行事曆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個信箱裡永遠有二十封未讀公文的同事
variations: 初級大人報稅：拖到最後一天，邊填邊冒冷汗。高級大人：早就用試算表把數字整理好了。

en.content:
Beginner adult gets an official document: the title alone makes their scalp tingle, so they set it aside, pretend they never saw it, and hope it vanishes on its own.

Senior adult gets a document: skims the key points in three minutes, replies to what needs replying, forwards the rest, and drops the deadline into their calendar.
en.editorNote: Tag the coworker whose inbox always has twenty unread official emails
variations: Beginner adult doing taxes: waits until the last day, filling it out in a cold sweat. Senior adult: had it all in a spreadsheet weeks ago.

items.sourceNote: adulting one-liner 'childhood heroes were figuring it out too' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
長大最崩潰的一刻，
是發現小時候覺得超厲害的大人，其實也是邊做邊猜、根本沒人知道自己在幹嘛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為只有自己還沒長大的朋友，其實大家都一樣
variations: 小時候以為大人什麼都懂，長大才發現，大人只是比較會裝作自己懂。

en.content:
The most unsettling part of growing up
is realizing the adults you thought had it all figured out were also just guessing as they went — nobody actually knew what they were doing.
en.editorNote: Send this to the friend who thinks they're the only one still winging it — spoiler: everyone is
variations: As a kid you think adults know everything. Then you grow up and learn they're just better at pretending they do.

items.sourceNote: 'emergency fund funded by hope and expired coupons' money struggle joke; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的緊急預備金：由希望、過期折價券，還有「相信熱水器不會壞」的信念組成。

高級大人的緊急預備金：一個獨立帳戶，碰都不碰。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次說要存錢、月底又歸零的朋友
variations: 初級大人存錢：存三天領出來。高級大人存錢：設定自動轉帳，眼不見為淨。

en.content:
Junior adult's emergency fund: made up of hope, expired coupons, and the firm belief that the water heater will never break.

Senior adult's emergency fund: a separate account they never touch.
en.editorNote: For the friend who swears they'll start saving and hits zero by month's end
variations: Junior adult saves money: withdraws it three days later. Senior adult: auto-transfer, out of sight, out of mind.

items.sourceNote: 'looking for an adult then realizing you are the adult' viral adulting quote; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
最恐怖的瞬間，
是遇到麻煩時本能地想找個大人來處理，然後才想起來——那個大人就是自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明長大了、遇事還是想喊「媽」的朋友
variations: 小時候覺得大人無所不能，長大才發現，大人只是沒有別的大人可以找了。

en.content:
The most terrifying moment:
something goes wrong, you instinctively look around for an adult to handle it — then remember that adult is you.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's all grown up but still wants to yell 'MOM' when things break
variations: As a kid you think adults can fix anything. Then you grow up and realize they just had no one else left to call.

items.sourceNote: adulting money-humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人存錢：這個月省下來的錢，下個月找個理由花掉。

高級大人存錢：先把錢轉走，剩下的才是這個月可以動的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都說「這次一定要開始存」的朋友，順便提醒他先設定自動轉帳
variations: 初級大人看帳單：假裝沒看到。高級大人看帳單：看到了，但已經預算好了。

en.content:
Junior adult saves money: whatever's left this month gets an excuse to be spent next month.

Senior adult saves money: moves it out first, and lives on whatever's still there.
en.editorNote: For the friend who swears every month is finally the month they start saving
variations: Junior adult reads the bill: pretends not to see it. Senior adult reads the bill: sees it, but already budgeted for it.

items.sourceNote: adulting burnout/rest theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人休息：等到累垮了，才允許自己躺平。

高級大人休息：還沒累之前，就先把休息排進行事曆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是撐到最後一刻才肯休息的朋友
variations: 初級大人放假：滑手機滑到罪惡感上身。高級大人放假：關掉通知，理直氣壯地耍廢。

en.content:
Junior adult rests: only lies down once they're already running on empty.

Senior adult rests: pencils the break into the calendar before the tank hits zero.
en.editorNote: For the friend who pushes until the very last second before they'll stop
variations: Junior adult on a day off: scrolls until the guilt kicks in. Senior adult on a day off: mutes notifications and does nothing, no apologies.

items.sourceNote: adulting decision-fatigue theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人做決定：問十個人的意見，最後還是不敢決定。

高級大人做決定：問自己一句「這件事一年後還重要嗎」，然後就走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個連午餐吃什麼都要開群組投票的朋友
variations: 初級大人選擇：怕選錯，所以什麼都不選。高級大人選擇：選了就不回頭，反正錯了再修。

en.content:
Junior adult makes a decision: asks ten people, then still can't commit.

Senior adult makes a decision: asks themselves 'will this matter in a year,' then moves on.
en.editorNote: For the friend who starts a group poll just to pick where to eat lunch
variations: Junior adult choosing: so scared of picking wrong they pick nothing. Senior adult choosing: picks it, no looking back, fixes it later if it's off.

items.sourceNote: adulting money/bills theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人領薪水：先買想要的，剩下的再看著辦。

高級大人領薪水：先付該付的，剩下的才是自己的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次月初像富翁、月底像難民的朋友
variations: 初級大人看帳單：假裝沒看到，過幾天再說。高級大人看帳單：當天處理掉，眼不見為淨的方式是真的看不見。

en.content:
Junior adult on payday: buys what they want first, figures out the rest later.

Senior adult on payday: pays what's due first, whatever's left is actually theirs.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's a millionaire on the 1st and a refugee by the 28th
variations: Junior adult with a bill: pretends they didn't see it, deals with it in a few days. Senior adult with a bill: handles it the same day, so 'out of sight' actually means gone.

items.sourceNote: adulting rent/subscription theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的訂閱：辦了一堆，一個都沒在用，還都在扣款。

高級大人的訂閱：每個月看一次帳單，用不到的當場退掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個手機裡有五個串流平台、每個都看不到三集的朋友
variations: 初級大人：錢是怎麼不見的完全沒概念。高級大人：錢去哪了一清二楚，因為都是自己送出去的。

en.content:
Junior adult's subscriptions: signed up for a dozen, uses none, still getting charged for all.

Senior adult's subscriptions: reviews the statement monthly, cancels anything they don't use on the spot.
en.editorNote: For the friend with five streaming apps who hasn't finished three episodes on any of them
variations: Junior adult: no idea where the money went. Senior adult: knows exactly where it went, because they're the one who sent it there.

items.sourceNote: adulting responsibility/priorities theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人面對一堆麻煩：全部一起慌，不知道先處理哪個。

高級大人面對一堆麻煩：挑最急的一件做，其他的排隊等。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一忙起來就整個人當機的朋友
variations: 初級大人：把所有事都當成緊急。高級大人：知道大部分的事，其實可以明天再說。

en.content:
Junior adult facing a pile of problems: panics about all of them at once, no idea which to start.

Senior adult facing a pile of problems: picks the most urgent one, the rest can wait in line.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose whole system crashes the moment things get busy
variations: Junior adult: treats everything as an emergency. Senior adult: knows most of it can honestly wait until tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: adulting acceptance/expectations theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人：以為長大就會什麼都搞定，結果越搞越亂。

高級大人：接受人生本來就一團亂，然後在亂裡面過得還不錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直在等「等我準備好」的朋友，其實沒有那一天
variations: 初級大人：等所有條件都齊了才敢開始。高級大人：邊做邊補，反正條件永遠不會齊。

en.content:
Junior adult: thought growing up meant everything would fall into place, then made a bigger mess.

Senior adult: accepts life is a mess by default, and manages to live pretty well inside it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who keeps waiting until they're 'ready' — spoiler, that day never comes
variations: Junior adult: waits for every condition to line up before starting. Senior adult: starts anyway and fills gaps along the way, because they never all line up.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人過年坐小孩桌 / 細路枱 meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人回家過年：自動坐到小孩桌，等長輩夾菜給你。

高級大人回家過年：坐主桌，負責發紅包、擋酒、決定幾點開飯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個三十歲了回家還是被當小孩、坐在電視前那桌吃飯的朋友
variations: 初級大人過年：被問「有沒有對象」只能傻笑。高級大人過年：反問長輩「今年身體檢查做了沒」，一秒轉移火力。

en.content:
Junior adult at a family reunion: drifts to the kids' table and waits for elders to load food onto their plate.

Senior adult at a family reunion: sits at the head table, hands out red envelopes, deflects the drinking, and calls when dinner starts.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's thirty and still gets seated at the kids' table every holiday
variations: Junior adult at the reunion: just grins when asked about their love life. Senior adult: fires back 'Did you get your annual checkup done?' and redirects the fire instantly.

items.sourceNote: adult money goes to boring maintenance theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大有錢就能亂買，
沒想到薪水下來，先繳的是保險、健檢、洗牙、還有機車突然要換的煞車皮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛發薪水就發現錢已經有主人的社畜，發薪日限定的清醒時刻
variations: 初級大人領到薪水：想著要買什麼犒賞自己。高級大人領到薪水：先把該扣的扣完，剩下的才敢當自己的。

en.content:
As a kid you thought having money meant buying whatever you want.
Turns out payday means insurance, a dental cleaning, a health checkup, and the brake pads your scooter suddenly needs.
en.editorNote: Share on payday with anyone who just watched their whole paycheck get claimed by boring, invisible expenses
variations: Junior adult on payday: plans a treat for themselves. Senior adult on payday: pays every bill first, and only what's left counts as actually theirs.

items.sourceNote: boundaries are not selfish / stop being a public utility theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人：怕拒絕別人會被討厭，於是什麼都答應，然後半夜偷偷後悔。

高級大人：知道會拒絕的人，別人反而更尊重你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠不會說不、被當成免費工具人的好人
variations: 初級大人：把「幫忙」當成義務，累到沒人謝謝也不敢生氣。高級大人：懂得留點力氣給自己，不當二十四小時待命的公用設施。

en.content:
Junior adult: says yes to everything out of fear of being disliked, then quietly regrets it at 2 AM.

Senior adult: knows that people who can say no actually get more respect.
en.editorNote: For the people-pleaser who never says no and keeps getting treated like a free utility
variations: Junior adult: treats every favor as an obligation and burns out without a single thank-you. Senior adult: saves some energy for themselves instead of running as a 24-hour public utility.

items.sourceNote: maturity is wanting peace over being right theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人吵架：一定要爭到對方認錯才肯停。

高級大人吵架：發現贏了道理、輸了整晚心情，於是選擇早點睡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明很累還要在群組堅持自己是對的的朋友，早點放過自己
variations: 初級大人：非要證明自己是對的。高級大人：發現有些人不值得你動氣，安靜比贏更划算。

en.content:
Junior adult in an argument: won't stop until the other person admits they're wrong.

Senior adult in an argument: realizes that winning the point but losing the whole evening isn't worth it, and just goes to bed early.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's exhausted but still insisting they're right in the group chat — let it go and sleep
variations: Junior adult: has to prove they're right. Senior adult: figures out some people aren't worth the anger, and peace beats winning every time.

items.sourceNote: 'I make money, the bills make it disappear, I'm the middleman' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人領薪水：先滑一輪購物車，覺得自己有錢了。

高級大人領薪水：薪水進帳三秒，帳單就把它接走，我只是中間經手的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每個月薪水都只是路過帳戶的朋友，一起苦笑
variations: 初級大人：以為薪水是收入。高級大人：發現薪水只是幫帳單跑腿的過路費。

en.content:
Junior adult on payday: scrolls the shopping cart first and feels rich.

Senior adult on payday: paycheck lands, the bills grab it three seconds later, and I'm just the middleman.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose paycheck merely passes through the account each month
variations: Junior adult: thinks the paycheck is income. Senior adult: realizes the paycheck is just a toll paid to run errands for the bills.

items.sourceNote: 'grocery shopping without a list = chaos' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人逛超市：沒帶清單，憑感覺買，結帳才發現三包餅乾一瓶醬油。

高級大人逛超市：清單、動線、預算都排好，進去五分鐘出來，剛剛好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次進超市都會失控多買一堆零食的朋友
variations: 初級大人：本來只想買衛生紙，出來手上多了四樣沒用的東西。高級大人：買什麼進門前就決定好了，不被貨架牽著走。

en.content:
Junior adult at the grocery store: no list, buys on vibes, checks out with three bags of chips and one bottle of soy sauce.

Senior adult at the grocery store: list, route, and budget all planned — in and out in five minutes, exactly what they came for.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always leaves the store with a cart full of snacks they never meant to buy
variations: Junior adult: went in for toilet paper, came out with four things they don't need. Senior adult: decided everything before walking in and never lets the shelves steer them.

items.sourceNote: 'used to dream big, now dream of eight hours of sleep' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人談夢想：想環遊世界、想成名、想改變世界。

高級大人談夢想：只想連睡八小時，中間不要醒來，起床不要腰痠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以前想征服世界、現在只想好好睡一覺的朋友
variations: 初級大人：討厭午睡，覺得浪費時間。高級大人：願意用一個週末換一次不被打擾的午睡。

en.content:
Junior adult talks dreams: travel the world, get famous, change everything.

Senior adult talks dreams: sleep eight hours straight, no waking up in the middle, no sore back in the morning.
en.editorNote: For the friend who once wanted to conquer the world and now just wants one good night's sleep
variations: Junior adult: hated naps, thought they were a waste of time. Senior adult: would trade a whole weekend for one uninterrupted afternoon nap.

items.sourceNote: 'paycheck comes in quietly, leaves dramatically' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人領薪水：先吃頓大餐犒賞自己，剩下的下個月再說。

高級大人領薪水：錢一進帳，自動轉三筆出去，剩下的才敢當作自己的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次薪水一入帳就開始倒數、月底喝西北風的朋友
variations: 初級大人看帳戶：發薪日前一天不敢打開。高級大人看帳戶：因為早就分好了，隨時打開都很平靜。

en.content:
Junior adult on payday: treats themselves to a fancy dinner first, deals with the rest next month.

Senior adult on payday: the moment the money lands, three transfers go out automatically — only then does what's left count as theirs.
en.editorNote: For the friend who starts a countdown the second their paycheck arrives and lives on air by month's end
variations: Junior adult checking their balance: won't open the app the day before payday. Senior adult: already split it up, so opening it anytime feels calm.

items.sourceNote: 'making plans then canceling them' / going out costs energy theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人約週末：先答應了，到當天才在群組裡想藉口。

高級大人約週末：當下就說「我那天想在家」，省下彼此的時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都先答應、到當天再裝病取消的朋友
variations: 初級大人：怕拒絕別人失禮，硬撐著出門。高級大人：知道最好的社交，是先把自己顧好。

en.content:
Junior adult making weekend plans: says yes right away, then hunts for an excuse in the group chat on the day.

Senior adult making weekend plans: says 'I'd rather stay in that day' on the spot, saving everyone the trouble.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always agrees, then fakes a cold to bail when the day arrives
variations: Junior adult: afraid saying no is rude, so they drag themselves out. Senior adult: knows the best socializing starts with taking care of yourself first.

items.sourceNote: 'upstairs ibuprofen, downstairs ibuprofen' / pack medicine not outfits theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人出門旅行：行李箱塞滿衣服，想著要拍幾套穿搭。

高級大人出門旅行：先確認止痛藥、胃藥、痠痛貼布有沒有帶，衣服隨便。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個出門開始帶藥、不再帶穿搭的朋友，笑著承認自己老了
variations: 初級大人：家裡一瓶止痛藥就夠。高級大人：樓上一瓶、樓下一瓶，包包裡再放一瓶。

en.content:
Junior adult packing for a trip: stuffs the suitcase with outfits, already planning the photos.

Senior adult packing for a trip: double-checks the painkillers, stomach meds, and muscle patches first — clothes are an afterthought.
en.editorNote: For the friend who now packs medicine instead of outfits and laughs while admitting they're getting old
variations: Junior adult: one bottle of ibuprofen at home is plenty. Senior adult: one upstairs, one downstairs, and a backup in the bag.

items.sourceNote: 'choosing which bill to panic over first' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人繳帳單：帳單堆到最後一天，才在慌張中挑哪張先繳。

高級大人繳帳單：全部設自動扣款，連哪天扣多少都不用記。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個帳單永遠拖到繳費期限最後一天的朋友
variations: 初級大人：看到帳單先深呼吸，決定今天先為哪一張焦慮。高級大人：帳單來了就一句「知道了」，然後繼續過日子。

en.content:
Junior adult paying bills: lets them pile up until the last day, then panics over which one to pay first.

Senior adult paying bills: everything's on autopay — doesn't even need to remember what gets charged when.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always drags every bill to the very last day of the deadline
variations: Junior adult: takes a deep breath at a new bill and decides which one to stress about today. Senior adult: sees a bill, says 'noted,' and gets on with life.

items.sourceNote: 'go to bed at 9:30 and still feel exhausted' / body in energy-saving mode theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的熬夜：凌晨兩點還在追劇，隔天照樣活蹦亂跳。

高級大人的熬夜：十點半上床，隔天還是累到像被卡車輾過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明睡得很早、卻永遠喊累的朋友，一起承認體力回不去了
variations: 初級大人：晚睡是自由。高級大人：早睡是奢侈，而且早睡也救不了那身疲憊。

en.content:
Junior adult staying up: still binging a show at 2 AM, bouncing around like normal the next day.

Senior adult staying up: in bed by 9:30 and still wakes up feeling like they got hit by a truck.
en.editorNote: For the friend who goes to bed early and somehow always feels wiped out — admit it together, the energy's not coming back
variations: Junior adult: staying up late is freedom. Senior adult: going to bed early is a luxury, and it still doesn't fix the exhaustion.

items.sourceNote: 'you save a little money and then your car makes a noise it never made before' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人存錢：好不容易存到一點錢，機車馬上發出從沒聽過的聲音。

高級大人存錢：早就準備好一筆「東西一定會壞」基金，壞了也只是淡定拿出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次戶頭剛有點餘額、家電就集體罷工的朋友
variations: 初級大人的存款：一存到整數，冰箱就開始怪怪的。高級大人的存款：早就分好一格叫「意外」，反正意外一定會來。

en.content:
Junior adult saving money: finally scrapes together some savings, and the car immediately makes a noise it's never made before.

Senior adult saving money: already has a 'something will break' fund set aside — when it does, they just calmly reach for it.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose appliances stage a group strike the moment their balance hits a round number
variations: Junior adult's savings: the second it hits a round number, the fridge starts acting weird. Senior adult's savings: there's already a slot labeled 'surprises,' because surprises always show up.

items.sourceNote: 'I buy groceries just to order takeout later' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人買菜：興沖沖買了一冰箱食材，最後全部拿來配外送。

高級大人買菜：只買會吃完的，剩下的預算直接留給外送，不騙自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個冰箱裡永遠有一包默默過期的青菜的朋友
variations: 初級大人：買菜是儀式，煮不煮是另一回事。高級大人：先承認今天不會煮，錢包比較快樂。

en.content:
Junior adult grocery shopping: enthusiastically fills a whole fridge, then eats it all alongside takeout anyway.

Senior adult grocery shopping: only buys what actually gets eaten, and honestly earmarks the rest of the budget for delivery.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always has one bag of vegetables quietly expiring in the crisper drawer
variations: Junior adult: buying groceries is a ritual; whether you cook is a separate issue. Senior adult: admits upfront they won't cook tonight — the wallet is happier that way.

items.sourceNote: 'told my boss I needed a raise because Gas, Electric and Water were after me' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人加薪理由：跟老闆說有三家公司在挖我。老闆問是哪三家，我說：水費、電費、瓦斯費。

高級大人加薪理由：帳單自動扣款前一天，把履歷更新一下就好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次帳單來就開始幻想離職的朋友，一起苦笑
variations: 初級大人：薪水進帳三天內最有錢，之後就是各種費用的提款機。高級大人：把自己當成別人帳單的訂閱制服務，看開了。

en.content:
Junior adult asking for a raise: told the boss three companies were after me. He asked which ones. I said: Water, Electric, and Gas.

Senior adult asking for a raise: just quietly updates the résumé the day before autopay hits.
en.editorNote: For the friend who starts daydreaming about quitting the moment a bill lands — laugh through it together
variations: Junior adult: richest for the three days after payday, an ATM for various fees after that. Senior adult: made peace with being a subscription service for everyone else's bills.

items.sourceNote: 'back pain is the notification your free trial of youth has ended' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的腰：熬夜、亂坐、亂躺，隔天照樣沒事。

高級大人的腰：只是彎腰撿了一支筆，就收到「青春試用期已結束」的通知。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個最近開始起身會發出聲音的朋友，一起承認保固到期了
variations: 初級大人：身體是免費吃到飽。高級大人：身體改成按次計費，而且每次都很貴。

en.content:
Junior adult's back: all-nighters, weird sitting, weird sleeping — totally fine the next day.

Senior adult's back: just bent down to pick up a pen and got the notification that the free trial of youth has ended.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's recently started making sound effects when they stand up — admit together the warranty's expired
variations: Junior adult: the body is an all-you-can-eat buffet. Senior adult: the body switched to pay-per-use, and every use is expensive.

items.sourceNote: 'exhausted at 9PM, wide awake at 3AM replaying an awkward moment' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人的夜：本來想熬夜追劇，九點就撐不住睡著；凌晨三點突然清醒，開始重播三年前講錯的那句話。

高級大人的夜：清楚自己幾點會斷電，提前把事情做完，然後心安理得地睡到天亮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個半夜會突然驚醒、腦內小劇場重播多年前糗事的朋友
variations: 初級大人：晚上捨不得睡，早上起不來。高級大人：把睡覺當成獎勵，準時去領獎。

en.content:
Junior adult's night: plans to binge a show, konks out by 9; snaps awake at 3 AM replaying that thing they said wrong three years ago.

Senior adult's night: knows exactly when the battery runs out, wraps up early, and sleeps guilt-free till morning.
en.editorNote: For the friend who jolts awake at night to rerun an embarrassing moment from years ago
variations: Junior adult: too stubborn to sleep at night, can't get up in the morning. Senior adult: treats sleep as a reward and clocks in on time to collect it.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 core trait: instinct to ask mom before handling paperwork; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人報稅：打開系統前，先截圖傳給媽媽問這格要填什麼。

高級大人報稅：換媽媽截圖傳來，問他這格要填什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個什麼流程一卡關，第一個念頭都是「等我問一下我媽」的朋友
variations: 初級大人：遇到表格就想找大人。高級大人：發現自己就是那個大人，只好硬著頭皮上。

en.content:
Junior adult doing taxes: screenshots the form and texts Mom to ask what goes in this box before even starting.

Senior adult doing taxes: now it's Mom screenshotting the form and texting them to ask what goes in this box.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose first instinct at any bureaucratic snag is 'hold on, let me ask my mom'
variations: Junior adult: sees a form and goes looking for a grown-up. Senior adult: realizes they are the grown-up now and just has to wing it.

items.sourceNote: 'adult head-shoulders-knees-toes is wallet-glasses-keys-phone' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人出門：手機、鑰匙、錢包，還是會漏掉其中一樣。

高級大人出門：手機、鑰匙、錢包、老花眼鏡、保溫瓶、常備藥，一樣都不會少——因為每一樣都是用忘記換來的教訓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個包包越揹越重、出門越來越像在打包避難的朋友
variations: 初級大人：出門三件事還是會忘。高級大人：出門三十件事一件都不忘，但也懶得出門了。

en.content:
Junior adult heading out: phone, keys, wallet — still manages to forget one.

Senior adult heading out: phone, keys, wallet, reading glasses, water bottle, backup meds — nothing missing, because every item is a lesson learned from once forgetting it.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose bag keeps getting heavier until leaving the house feels like packing for an evacuation
variations: Junior adult: three things to grab and still forgets one. Senior adult: thirty things to grab and forgets none — but also can't be bothered to go out.

items.sourceNote: 'trying to remember our passwords' modern-adulting theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人忘記密碼：直接按「忘記密碼」，重設一個新的，下次再忘。

高級大人忘記密碼：早就全部丟進密碼管理器，忘記的是打開管理器的那組主密碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每個網站密碼都一樣、卻還是常常登不進去的朋友
variations: 初級大人：密碼設成生日，方便記。高級大人：密碼設成一長串亂碼，方便忘。

en.content:
Junior adult forgets a password: just hits 'forgot password,' resets a new one, and forgets that one too.

Senior adult forgets a password: put them all in a password manager ages ago — the one they forgot is the master password to open it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who uses the same password everywhere and still can't log in half the time
variations: Junior adult: sets the password to their birthday so it's easy to remember. Senior adult: sets it to a random string so it's easy to forget.

items.sourceNote: 'sleeping wrong can disable me for three days' aging-humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人受傷：打球扭到腳，冰敷一下隔天照跑。

高級大人受傷：睡姿不對，脖子廢三天，還想不起來到底哪一覺睡壞的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個最近開始會「莫名其妙就閃到腰」的朋友，讓他默默點頭
variations: 初級大人：熬夜隔天照樣生龍活虎。高級大人：早睡隔天還是覺得被卡車輾過。

en.content:
Junior adult gets hurt: twists an ankle playing ball, ices it, runs again the next day.

Senior adult gets hurt: sleeps in a slightly wrong position, neck out of commission for three days, and can't even pinpoint which night did it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's recently started 'throwing their back out for no reason' — they'll nod quietly
variations: Junior adult: pulls an all-nighter and is fine the next day. Senior adult: goes to bed early and still wakes up feeling run over by a truck.

items.sourceNote: 'three cups of coffee counts as a meal' adulting theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人吃飯：餓了就叫外送，正餐宵夜分得清清楚楚。

高級大人吃飯：早上一杯咖啡，中午一杯咖啡，下午再一杯——這樣算不算吃了三餐？
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把「等等再吃」講到天黑、最後用咖啡當三餐的工作狂朋友
variations: 初級大人：一天沒吃飯會餓到發脾氣。高級大人：一天沒吃飯到晚上才想起來，還覺得挺有效率。

en.content:
Junior adult eats: orders delivery the second they're hungry, clear line between meals and midnight snacks.

Senior adult eats: coffee in the morning, coffee at noon, one more in the afternoon — does that count as three meals?
en.editorNote: For the workaholic friend who says 'I'll eat later' until it's dark out and then calls coffee dinner
variations: Junior adult: skips one meal and gets hangry. Senior adult: skips eating all day, remembers at night, and feels weirdly productive about it.

items.sourceNote: 'hoping the check engine light stays off one more week' theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人遇到警示燈：亮了就慌，馬上打給家人問怎麼辦。

高級大人遇到警示燈：亮了就假裝沒看到，默默祈禱它撐到下個月發薪再說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個機車儀表板亮紅燈、還在跟它「談判」再騎一週的朋友
variations: 初級大人：東西壞了就換新的。高級大人：東西壞了先問「還能不能撐」，撐到不能撐為止。

en.content:
Junior adult sees a warning light: panics the moment it lights up, calls family to ask what to do.

Senior adult sees a warning light: pretends not to see it, quietly praying it holds out until next payday.
en.editorNote: For the friend still 'negotiating' one more week out of the red light on their dashboard
variations: Junior adult: something breaks, buys a new one. Senior adult: something breaks, first asks 'can it hold out a bit longer?' — and rides it till it can't.

items.sourceNote: '初級大人 buying fruit still asks mom' viral Threads example; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人買水果：站在攤位前拍照傳給媽，問哪一顆比較甜。

高級大人買水果：手一按就知道熟度，順便教旁邊那個在拍照的年輕人怎麼挑。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個超市選個蔥都要視訊求救的朋友，笑著承認就是他
variations: 初級大人：買菜像在解謎，每一樣都要問。高級大人：買菜像在巡田，閉著眼睛都挑得到。

en.content:
Junior adult buying fruit: stands at the stall photographing everything to text Mom, asking which one's sweeter.

Senior adult buying fruit: knows ripeness with one press, then teaches the kid next to them how to pick.
en.editorNote: For the friend who video-calls for backup just to choose scallions at the store — they'll laugh and own it
variations: Junior adult: grocery shopping is a puzzle, every item needs a phone-a-friend. Senior adult: grocery shopping is a stroll through their own field, picks the good ones with their eyes closed.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 unsure about praying rituals viral Threads example; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人拜拜：香拿反了、順序全忘，只能站旁邊偷看媽媽先拜哪一尊。

高級大人拜拜：三炷香一插，順口就把整套流程講給旁邊那個手足無措的年輕人聽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每逢過年拜拜就全程跟著長輩比手勢的朋友
variations: 初級大人：拜拜要問幾炷香、拜幾拜。高級大人：閉著眼睛都知道哪尊先拜、要說什麼。

en.content:
Junior adult praying at the temple: holds the incense backwards, forgets the order, and just watches Mom to see which deity she bows to first.

Senior adult praying: plants the three sticks in one smooth move, then casually walks the flustered kid beside them through the whole ritual.
en.editorNote: For the friend who mirrors every elder's hand movement during holiday prayers
variations: Junior adult: has to ask how many incense sticks and how many bows. Senior adult: knows which deity comes first and what to say, eyes closed.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 needs help with insurance/tax paperwork viral trend; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人看保單：打開文件三行就投降，直接截圖傳家庭群組問「這個我有保嗎」。

高級大人看保單：一眼看出哪條理賠有陷阱，還順便提醒你續約前記得比價。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個保險全靠爸媽當年幫忙保、自己一條都看不懂的人
variations: 初級大人：出事才發現不知道自己有沒有保。高級大人：出事前就把理賠流程背得滾瓜爛熟。

en.content:
Junior adult reading an insurance policy: gives up after three lines, screenshots it to the family group chat asking 'am I even covered for this?'

Senior adult reading a policy: spots the fine-print trap in one glance, then reminds you to compare quotes before you renew.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose parents set up every policy years ago and who can't read a single clause
variations: Junior adult: only finds out at claim time whether they're covered. Senior adult: has the whole claims process memorized before anything happens.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 asks family before handling home repairs viral thread; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人家裡漏水：先拍影片傳給爸，問「這個很嚴重嗎」，然後全家一起看著它滴。

高級大人家裡漏水：關總水閥、找出接頭，水電師傅還沒到就先自己纏好止漏帶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個馬桶水箱一漏就整晚睡不著、只會拿臉盆接水的朋友
variations: 初級大人：東西壞了第一個念頭是打給家人。高級大人：東西壞了第一個念頭是找工具箱在哪。

en.content:
Junior adult with a leak at home: films it for Dad first, asks 'is this serious?', then the whole family stands around watching it drip.

Senior adult with a leak: shuts the main valve, finds the joint, and wraps the seal tape themselves before the plumber even arrives.
en.editorNote: For the friend who loses a whole night's sleep over a leaky toilet tank and just sticks a bucket under it
variations: Junior adult: something breaks, first instinct is to call family. Senior adult: something breaks, first instinct is to find where the toolbox is.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 asks GPT how much water for rice cooker viral example; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人煮飯：不知道電鍋外鍋也要加水，站在冒煙的鍋子前問 GPT「一杯米配幾杯水」。

高級大人煮飯：外鍋一杯水的手感在心裡，順便告訴你今天的米要少放一點水才 Q。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個第一次用電鍋煮出「米香焦味特調」的室友
variations: 初級大人：食譜寫「適量」就當機。高級大人：「適量」就是他手一抓的那個量。

en.content:
Junior adult cooking rice: doesn't know the cooker's outer pot needs water too, stands in front of a smoking pot asking GPT 'how many cups of water per cup of rice?'

Senior adult cooking rice: has the one-cup-in-the-outer-pot feel memorized, and tells you today's rice needs a touch less water to come out chewy.
en.editorNote: For the roommate whose first go at the rice cooker produced a 'burnt-rice aroma special'
variations: Junior adult: freezes the moment a recipe says 'to taste.' Senior adult: 'to taste' is exactly the handful they just grabbed.

items.sourceNote: parallel-parking-as-adulting-win relatable quote; rewritten original into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人停車：路邊一個大車位，來回喬了五次，最後放棄再繞去找收費停車場。

高級大人停車：一把方向盤到底，一次入庫，下車還順手幫後面那台指揮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到路邊停車就先深呼吸、寧願多走三個路口的朋友
variations: 初級大人：能停進去就謝天謝地。高級大人：停完還嫌自己離線差了五公分。

en.content:
Junior adult parking: a big open spot on the street, shuffles back and forth five times, then gives up and circles off to find a paid garage.

Senior adult parking: one full turn of the wheel, in on the first try, and hops out to wave the car behind them in too.
en.editorNote: For the friend who takes a deep breath at the sight of any street spot and would rather walk three extra blocks
variations: Junior adult: just getting in at all is a blessing. Senior adult: parks perfectly and still complains they're five centimeters off the line.

items.sourceNote: 'I make money, the bills make it disappear, I am the middleman' relatable line; rewritten into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人領薪水：看到入帳數字爽了三秒，然後帳單、房租、卡費輪流來認領。

高級大人領薪水：早就分好帳戶，薪水進來連摸都沒摸到就各就各位。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每個月五號很有錢、十號就開始吃泡麵的朋友
variations: 初級大人的薪水：我只是負責幫錢從公司搬到帳單的中間人。高級大人的薪水：進來之前就知道它要去哪。

en.content:
Junior adult on payday: enjoys the deposit number for three seconds, then rent, bills, and the credit card line up to claim it.

Senior adult on payday: already split it across accounts — the money marches to its posts without ever being touched.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's rich on the 5th and eating instant noodles by the 10th
variations: Junior adult's paycheck: I'm just the middleman moving money from work to the bills. Senior adult's paycheck: it knew where it was going before it arrived.

items.sourceNote: 'grocery store used to be fun, now it's a budget horror show' relatable line; rewritten into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人買菜：進超市想買三樣，結帳前先把籃子裡的東西默默放回去兩樣。

高級大人買菜：手機開著特價 App，哪家蛋便宜、哪天青菜打折全在腦裡，一趟就搞定一週。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到菜價會倒抽一口氣、然後假裝很淡定的朋友
variations: 初級大人：以為超市是逛街，結果是驚魂記。高級大人：連折扣時段都算好了才出門。

en.content:
Junior adult grocery shopping: walks in for three things, then quietly puts two back before the register.

Senior adult grocery shopping: deals app open, knows which store has cheap eggs and which day the greens go on sale, one trip covers the week.
en.editorNote: For the friend who gasps at the price of eggs and then pretends to be totally chill about it
variations: Junior adult: thought the grocery store was a fun outing, turns out it's a budget horror show. Senior adult: timed the whole trip around the discount window.

items.sourceNote: 'school taught me algebra, life teaches me taxes I still don't understand' relatable line; rewritten into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人報稅：打開系統十分鐘，欄位看不懂，最後傳訊息問爸媽「這個要填哪裡」。

高級大人報稅：早就把單據分好類，登入十五分鐘搞定，順便提醒你哪個扣除額別忘了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年五月都要打電話回家求救的朋友
variations: 初級大人：學校教我二元一次方程式，人生叫我報稅，而我兩個都不會。高級大人：報稅像在填每天的行事曆一樣順。

en.content:
Junior adult filing taxes: opens the portal, stares at fields they don't understand for ten minutes, then texts mom and dad 'where does this go?'

Senior adult filing taxes: receipts already sorted, done in fifteen minutes, and reminds you not to forget that one deduction.
en.editorNote: For the friend who calls home for a rescue every tax season
variations: Junior adult: school taught me algebra, life taught me taxes, and I understand neither. Senior adult: files taxes as smoothly as filling in their calendar.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 home-repair/on-the-spot-judgment scenario from Threads trend coverage; rewritten original into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人家裡東西壞了：站在漏水的水龍頭前，先錄影傳到家庭群組問「這個要找誰」。

高級大人家裡東西壞了：關總開關、擦地板、打給熟識的師傅，三步驟一氣呵成。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個遇到任何家電故障第一反應是拍照求救的室友
variations: 初級大人：東西一壞就當機，只會問「怎麼辦」。高級大人：怎麼辦？先止血，再說。

en.content:
Junior adult when something breaks at home: stands in front of the leaking faucet, films it, and drops it in the family chat asking 'who do I call for this?'

Senior adult when something breaks at home: shuts the main valve, mops the floor, calls the plumber they already know — three steps, no pause.
en.editorNote: For the roommate whose first reaction to any broken appliance is to take a photo and ask for help
variations: Junior adult: freezes the second something breaks and just asks 'what do I do?' Senior adult: what do I do? Stop the bleeding first, talk later.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 ritual/拜拜 uncertainty scenario from Threads trend coverage; rewritten original into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人拜拜：香點好了，站在神明前完全不知道要拜幾下、什麼順序，只能偷瞄旁邊的媽媽。

高級大人拜拜：香一點，順序、句子、幾拜幾插，一整套流程行雲流水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每年跟著拜都要先看爸媽動作才敢動的你
variations: 初級大人：不知道先拜哪一尊，只好等別人先動。高級大人：進廟就知道動線，還會提醒你金紙怎麼折。

en.content:
Junior adult at the temple: incense lit, standing in front of the altar with no idea how many bows or what order — sneaking a look at Mom.

Senior adult at the temple: lights the incense and runs the whole ritual — order, words, bows — without a second thought.
en.editorNote: For the one who still copies their parents' every move at family prayers
variations: Junior adult: no clue which deity to greet first, so just waits for someone else to go. Senior adult: knows the whole route the moment they walk in — and reminds you how to fold the offering paper.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人 insurance/paperwork judgment scenario from Threads trend coverage; rewritten original into contrast format

zh-tw.content:
初級大人看保單：每個字都看得懂，合起來一句都看不懂，最後傳給爸媽問「這個要保嗎」。

高級大人看保單：直接看重點——理賠範圍、除外條款、繳費年期，五分鐘決定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個保險業務講完還是一頭霧水、只能回家問長輩的朋友
variations: 初級大人：以為保險就是繳錢買心安。高級大人：清楚自己保的是什麼、什麼時候用得到。

en.content:
Junior adult reading an insurance policy: understands every single word, understands zero sentences, ends up texting their parents 'should I get this one?'

Senior adult reading a policy: goes straight to what matters — coverage, exclusions, payment term — decides in five minutes.
en.editorNote: For the friend who nods through the whole sales pitch and still has to ask an elder at home
variations: Junior adult: thinks insurance is just paying money for peace of mind. Senior adult: knows exactly what they're covered for and when it kicks in.

items.sourceNote: 'body files incident reports' relatable adulting line; rewritten original into 以為長大後 format

zh-tw.content: 小時候以為長大後身體會越來越耐操。長大後才發現，睡個覺也能落枕——身體從此不修東西，只發事故報告。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個最近開始「無緣無故」這裡痛那裡痠的同齡朋友
variations: 以前跌倒拍拍就好，現在坐太久，站起來還要先預熱。

en.content: As a kid I figured my body would only get tougher with age. Turns out you can throw your neck out just by sleeping — the body stopped repairing itself and now just files incident reports.
en.editorNote: For the same-age friend who's suddenly sore 'for no reason' everywhere
variations: Used to fall down and bounce right back. Now standing up after sitting too long requires a warm-up.

items.sourceNote: 'errands as accomplishment / parallel parking win' relatable adulting lines; rewritten and combined into 以為長大後 format

zh-tw.content: 小時候覺得週末辦雜事是一種懲罰。長大後，一天之內繳完帳單、倒完垃圾、還把車停進超小的車位——這就是我今天的高光時刻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把「今天路邊停車一次到位」當成一整天成就的朋友
variations: 以前的成就是考一百分，現在的成就是準時把回收拿出去倒。

en.content: As a kid, running errands on the weekend felt like a punishment. As an adult, paying all the bills, taking out the trash, and squeezing the car into a tiny spot all in one day — that's the highlight of my whole day.
en.editorNote: For the friend who counts 'nailed the parallel park on the first try' as a full day's achievement
variations: Used to feel accomplished acing a test. Now it's getting the recycling out on the right night.

items.sourceNote: 'being an adult means being tired' relatable adulting theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
當大人其實很簡單：
就是隨時都很累，然後跟別人說你很累，
對方再跟你說他也很累。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到那個每天早上第一句話都是「好累」的群組，大家一起累
variations: 小時候最怕被叫去睡覺，長大後最想要的生日禮物是一整天不被打擾的睡覺。

en.content:
Being an adult is honestly pretty simple:
you're tired all the time, you tell people you're tired,
and they tell you they're tired too.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat where everyone's first message is 'so tired' — instant solidarity
variations: As a kid, bedtime was the worst punishment. As an adult, a full day of uninterrupted sleep is the birthday gift I actually want.

items.sourceNote: 'adult money goes to maintenance' meme theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大賺的錢會拿去買名牌、去旅行、天天吃早午餐，
沒想到大部分都拿去補車險、換濾網、繳健保、買衛生紙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個薪水一入帳就馬上變成一疊帳單的朋友
variations: 以為長大後的購物車裝的是包包和機票，結果裝的是垃圾袋、洗衣精和感冒藥。

en.content:
As a kid you thought your grown-up paycheck would go to designer bags, trips, and daily brunch.
Turns out most of it goes to car insurance, air filters, deductibles, and toilet paper.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose paycheck turns into a stack of bills the second it lands
variations: Thought my adult shopping cart would be full of handbags and plane tickets. It's trash bags, laundry detergent, and cold medicine.

items.sourceNote: 'same decisions respawn like side quests' adulting meme theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
當大人最累的地方，就是同樣的選擇要一直重做：
今天晚餐吃什麼、明天晚餐吃什麼、後天晚餐吃什麼——
這根本是一個永遠刷不完的支線任務。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個負責全家伙食、每天為「吃什麼」內耗的人
variations: 以為長大是打大魔王，結果每天都在重複打小怪：洗碗、倒垃圾、想晚餐，刷完隔天又重生。

en.content:
The most exhausting part of being an adult is making the same decision on repeat:
what's for dinner tonight, what's for dinner tomorrow, what's for dinner the day after —
it's a side quest that respawns the second you finish it.
en.editorNote: For whoever's in charge of feeding the household and quietly loses it over 'what's for dinner'
variations: Thought adulthood was fighting the final boss. It's actually grinding the same low-level mobs every day: dishes, trash, dinner — cleared, and they respawn by morning.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 家中大小事處理能力 contrast; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人收到政府公文：拍照傳到家庭群組問「這什麼意思？」

高級大人收到政府公文：看一眼、簽名、順手把水電費也繳了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠在群組裡當「這什麼意思」發問方的家人
variations: 初級大人家裡跳電：先在群組發問。高級大人家裡跳電：走去電箱把總開關推回去。

en.content:
Junior adult gets an official government letter: snaps a photo to the family chat asking 'what does this mean?'

Senior adult gets the same letter: glances at it, signs it, and pays the utility bill while they're at it.
en.editorNote: Tag the family member who's forever the one asking 'wait, what does this mean?' in the group chat
variations: Junior adult when the power trips: posts in the family chat first. Senior adult when the power trips: walks to the breaker box and flips it back.

items.sourceNote: John Mulaney 'pretending to be an adult' bit theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
每天最搞笑的事，就是努力假裝自己是個大人。
我常常在想：是不是該穿件西裝外套、拿把傘、提個公事包出門？
因為我還在照著小時候電視上看到的大人模樣演。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個開會前要對鏡子練習「成熟表情」的朋友，其實我們都在演
variations: 所謂長大，就是一邊在會議上點頭說「沒問題」，一邊心裡完全不知道自己在同意什麼。

en.content:
The funniest part of my day is trying to act like an adult.
I keep wondering: should I put on a blazer, carry an umbrella, walk around with a briefcase?
Because I'm still performing whatever adult I saw on TV as a kid.
en.editorNote: For the friend who practices their 'mature face' in the mirror before meetings — we're all just performing
variations: Growing up is nodding 'sounds good' in a meeting while having absolutely no idea what you just agreed to.

items.sourceNote: millennial reunion / peer-comparison humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人去同學會：想好要怎麼講自己的近況才不會輸。
高級大人去同學會：只想確認大家都跟我一樣累。
結果全場最受歡迎的話題是「你家的房貸利率多少」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給同學會群組裡那個一直在敲你「來啦」的班長
variations: 同學會的座位表，會自動照「誰還睡得著」重新排列。
以前同學會比誰混得好，現在比誰的健檢紅字少。

en.content:
Junior adult at a reunion: rehearsing how to describe your life so it sounds like you're winning.
Senior adult at a reunion: just confirming everyone else is this tired too.
And the most popular topic of the night ends up being mortgage rates.
en.editorNote: Send to the classmate who keeps spamming the group chat about this year's reunion
variations: Reunion seating naturally rearranges itself by who still sleeps through the night.
We used to compare job titles at reunions. Now we compare bloodwork.

items.sourceNote: millennial 'concert stamina' humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人搶票：一定要最前面，站三小時算什麼。
高級大人搶票：先看有沒有座位區，再看散場好不好走。
最後買了座位票，站起來跟著唱十分鐘，坐下來喝水休息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你一起看演唱會、中場說「我去坐一下」的朋友
variations: 長大就是把「離舞台多近」換成「離廁所多近」。
以前挑演唱會看誰來唱，現在挑演唱會看幾點結束。

en.content:
Junior adult buying concert tickets: front row or nothing, three hours standing is fine.
Senior adult buying concert tickets: seated section first, then how bad the exit crowd will be.
Ends up seated, stands for ten minutes of singing, sits back down for water.
en.editorNote: For the friend who says 'I'm gonna go sit down' halfway through the opener
variations: Growing up is swapping 'how close to the stage' for 'how close to the bathroom.'
I used to pick concerts by who was playing. Now I pick them by what time it ends.

items.sourceNote: adult social-obligation cost humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為長大後收到喜帖會很開心。
長大後收到喜帖，第一個動作是查行事曆，第二個動作是心算。
第三個動作是傳給另一個朋友問：「你包多少？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都跟你套好金額才敢填喜帖的朋友
variations: 喜帖不是邀請函，是繳費通知單。
成年人的友情測試：他敢不敢直接跟你說他包多少。

en.content:
As a kid I thought getting a wedding invite would feel exciting.
As an adult, step one is checking the calendar, step two is doing math in my head.
Step three is texting another friend: 'okay, how much are you giving?'
en.editorNote: For the friend you always coordinate gift amounts with before RSVPing
variations: A wedding invitation isn't an invitation. It's an invoice with nice lettering.
Real adult friendship is someone telling you their actual gift number first.

items.sourceNote: online-shopping / avoidance humor theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
初級大人買錯東西：立刻申請退貨，據理力爭。
高級大人買錯東西：看一眼退貨流程，決定把它當成一筆學費。
家裡那個抽屜，就是我的學費繳納紀錄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個櫃子裡塞滿「當初想說會用到」的朋友
variations: 成年人的極限運動：填退貨單。
我不是懶得退貨，我是在替自己買下一個「不要再衝動」的教訓。

en.content:
Junior adult buys the wrong thing: files a return immediately, argues the case.
Senior adult buys the wrong thing: reads the return policy once and files it under tuition.
That drawer in my apartment is just a receipt collection of lessons learned.
en.editorNote: For the friend with a whole cabinet of stuff they swore they'd use
variations: Extreme sport for adults: actually completing a return before the window closes.
It's not laziness. I'm paying for the lesson to stop impulse-buying.

items.sourceNote: aging-body physical comedy theme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
長大的第一個徵兆，不是繳稅，也不是加班。
是你發現自己不能再站著單腳穿褲子了。
現在穿褲子要先找一面牆，那面牆就是你的成年禮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個早上換衣服會不小心撞到衣櫃的朋友
variations: 身體的更新公告都不會事先通知，直接就上線了。
以為長大後會變得更靈活，結果連撿東西都要先想一下路線。

en.content:
The first real sign of adulthood isn't taxes or overtime.
It's the day you can't put on pants standing on one leg anymore.
Now getting dressed requires a wall, and that wall is your coming-of-age ceremony.
en.editorNote: For the friend who bumps into the closet door every morning getting dressed
variations: Your body ships updates without a changelog and without asking.
I thought I'd get more coordinated as an adult. Now I plan a route before picking something up off the floor.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 Threads trend; original angle on Taiwan garbage-truck chase, not present in existing items

zh-tw.content:
初級大人倒垃圾：聽到少女的祈禱才開始找垃圾袋，穿著拖鞋衝下樓，眼睜睜看垃圾車轉彎走掉。

高級大人倒垃圾：垃圾車還在三條街外，人已經站在定點，袋子分類綁好，等它來。

那首音樂對初級大人是警報，對高級大人是背景音樂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都追著垃圾車跑一整條巷子的朋友
variations: 初級大人聽到垃圾車：先愣三秒，確認今天是不是收垃圾的日子。高級大人聽到垃圾車：袋子早就在門口了。
長大的一個指標，是你終於背得出自家垃圾車幾點會到那個路口。

en.content:
Junior adult taking out the trash: only starts hunting for a bag when the truck's jingle is already playing, sprints downstairs in slippers, and watches it turn the corner and drive off.

Senior adult taking out the trash: truck's still three streets away, but they're already standing at the pickup spot, bags sorted and tied, waiting.

That little tune is an alarm to one, and background music to the other.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who chases the garbage truck down the whole alley every single time
variations: Junior adult hears the truck: freezes for three seconds trying to remember if today is even a collection day. Senior adult: the bag's been waiting by the door for an hour.
One sign you've grown up: you've memorized exactly what time the truck hits your corner.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 contrast; original angle on online-shopping free-shipping threshold

zh-tw.content:
初級大人網購：本來只要買一個充電線，為了湊免運，硬是又加了三樣用不到的東西，總共多花四百塊，省下六十塊運費。

高級大人網購：需要什麼買什麼，運費該付就付。

所謂省錢，有時候只是換一種方式花錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個購物車永遠停在「差一百塊免運」的朋友
variations: 初級大人為了免運加購的東西，通常會在半年後被你在抽屜深處重新發現。
「湊免運」是這個時代最貴的四個字。

en.content:
Junior adult shopping online: came for one charging cable, then piled on three things they'll never use just to hit free shipping — spent an extra $14 to save the $2 delivery fee.

Senior adult shopping online: buys what they need, pays the shipping when there's shipping.

Sometimes 'saving money' is just spending it in a different outfit.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend whose cart is permanently stuck at 'add $4 more for free shipping'
variations: The stuff you add to unlock free shipping is the exact stuff you rediscover in the back of a drawer six months later.
'Free shipping' might be the most expensive two words online.

items.sourceNote: Flat-pack furniture / leftover screws adulting humor; rewritten into 初級/高級 format, not present in existing items

zh-tw.content:
初級大人組家具：說明書看不懂，反正先鎖上去再說，裝完站起來，地上還剩五根螺絲，決定假裝沒看到。

高級大人組家具：先把零件全部分類擺好，照步驟一步一步來，裝完剛剛好，一根不多。

那五根多出來的螺絲，就是初級大人的簽名。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個組完櫃子總是多出零件、然後說「這是備用的」的朋友
variations: 初級大人組完家具：搖一搖，還算穩，決定它就長這樣了。高級大人組完家具：連背板都鎖好，抽屜滑得跟展示間一樣。
多出來的那幾根螺絲，你永遠不敢丟，但也永遠不會用到。

en.content:
Junior adult assembling furniture: can't decode the instructions, just screws things in and hopes, stands up when it's done — five screws still on the floor, decides to pretend they don't exist.

Senior adult assembling furniture: lays out and sorts every part first, follows each step in order, finishes with exactly zero pieces left.

Those five leftover screws are the junior adult's signature.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who always has spare parts after building a shelf and insists 'those are just extras'
variations: Junior adult, furniture done: gives it a wobble, calls it stable enough, decides that's just how it looks now. Senior adult: even the back panel is screwed in, drawers glide like a showroom.
Those leftover screws — you'll never dare throw them out, and you'll never actually use them.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 contrast; original angle on reading health-check red values (booking is covered elsewhere, reading the report is not)

zh-tw.content:
初級大人拿到健檢報告：看到一個紅字，心跳漏一拍，凌晨兩點開始 Google，把自己嚇到不敢睡，隔天什麼都沒做。

高級大人拿到健檢報告：紅字圈起來，掛號、追蹤、調整作息，一項一項處理掉。

同一張報告，一個拿來焦慮，一個拿來當待辦清單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次體檢紅字都先 Google 到天亮的朋友
variations: 初級大人看到紅字：想像最壞的結果。高級大人看到紅字：預約下一次的複檢。
報告上的紅字不會因為你不看就變黑，只會因為你不看變多。

en.content:
Junior adult gets their health-check report: sees one number in red, heart skips, starts Googling at 2 AM, scares themselves out of sleep, and does absolutely nothing about it the next day.

Senior adult gets their health-check report: circles the red values, books the follow-up, tweaks their habits, and clears each one off the list.

Same report — one person turns it into anxiety, the other turns it into a to-do list.
en.editorNote: Tag the friend who Googles every red value on their bloodwork until sunrise
variations: Junior adult sees a red value: imagines the worst-case ending. Senior adult sees a red value: schedules the recheck.
A red number on the report doesn't turn black because you ignore it. It just multiplies.

items.sourceNote: 初級大人/高級大人 family group chat angle; original take on becoming the morning-greeting-image sender

zh-tw.content:
初級大人在家庭群組：長輩圖跳出來只按個讚，心裡覺得那些早安圖有點好笑。

高級大人在家庭群組：某天早上，你也傳了一張「早安，記得吃早餐」的花朵圖，而且是真心的。

你沒有變老，你只是終於懂了那張圖裡的溫柔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個某天發現自己開始存早安圖的朋友
variations: 分辨長大的方式很簡單：你以前笑早安圖，現在你收藏早安圖。
初級大人已讀家庭群組不回。高級大人在群組裡負責提醒大家降溫、多喝水、颱風天別出門。

en.content:
Junior adult in the family group chat: an elder's flowery 'good morning' image pops up, they just tap like, secretly finding those graphics a little silly.

Senior adult in the family group chat: one morning, you send a 'Good morning, don't skip breakfast' flower graphic yourself — and you mean it.

You didn't get old. You finally understood the tenderness inside that image.
