Every Sunday night I line up five lunch boxes and flip each lid over to sit under its own box.

I pack the rice with the back of a spoon, three presses, until no gaps show, so all five come out about the same weight.

The one on the far left gets an extra piece of meat; that one is for Friday, and on Fridays I usually get home past nine.

The five lids snap shut with the same sound, and I slide them into the fridge one at a time, until the door bumps the outermost box on its way closed.
en.editorNote: Good for weekend meal prep, or for talking about how you get yourself through a week, and for anyone else cooking on a Sunday night
variations: Short: Five lunch boxes, three presses with the back of a spoon, and one extra piece of meat in the box on the far left.
Extended: The extra piece is Friday's. I have never weighed it. I only know that day needs a little more.

items.sourceNote: 中央氣象署氣候服務入口網秋季氣候頁：九月下旬後冷空氣南下形成東北季風、十一月為北部最乾月份、十一站秋季平均氣溫約攝氏二十五點一度；作為換季悶熱情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
入秋第三週的下午三十三度，我把客廳大燈按掉，只留玄關那盞壁燈。

電風扇轉到最小格，我坐在地板上，背靠著壁燈照出來的那圈淡黃。

窗外一片雲也沒有動，馬路的柏油面蒸出一層看得見的熱。

我把冰塊倒進杯子，數了四顆，杯子貼在後頸上，一直坐到牆上那圈黃變成整間房最亮的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合換季那幾天悶在家裡的時候分享，也適合傳給同樣把大燈關掉只留一盞小燈的人
variations: 短版：下午三十三度，客廳大燈按掉，只留玄關那盞壁燈，我坐在地板上。
延伸版：那四顆冰塊化完的時間我沒有量，只知道化完之後，牆上那圈黃看起來比剛才更黃一點。

en.content:
Third week of autumn, thirty-three degrees in the afternoon, and I switched off the ceiling light in the living room, leaving only the wall lamp by the entryway.

I turned the fan down to its lowest setting and sat on the floor with my back against the ring of pale yellow the wall lamp threw on the paint.

Not one cloud outside the window moved, and the asphalt on the road gave off a layer of heat you could actually see.

I dropped ice into a glass, counted four cubes, held the glass against the back of my neck, and stayed there until that ring of yellow was the brightest thing in the room.
en.editorNote: Good for those stuck-indoors days when the season refuses to turn, and for anyone who kills the ceiling light and keeps one small lamp on
variations: Short: Thirty-three degrees in the afternoon. Ceiling light off, entryway wall lamp on, me on the floor.
Extended: I never timed how long those four cubes took to melt. I only know that afterward the yellow on the wall looked a shade yellower.

items.sourceNote: MAYO鼎恒數位「颱風假有薪水嗎」專文：颱風假並非勞基法假別、勞動部強調以不出勤為原則、雇主不得片面要求改為居家上班；作為颱風夜留在家中情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
海警發布的晚上，風把窗框推得一直響，我沿著牆把三扇窗的鎖依序扳到底。

家裡跳電兩次，之後我只開走廊那盞壁燈，其他開關全部按下去。

雨從八點下到十二點，中間歇了大約二十分鐘，我趁那段時間把水壺和兩個鍋子裝滿。

天亮風還在吹，我站在窗前把昨晚沒收的衣架收進來，掛勾上還吊著一串沒有掉下去的水珠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合颱風夜或停班消息還沒出來的晚上分享，也適合傳給那個一個人在家守著窗戶的朋友
variations: 短版：跳電兩次之後，家裡只剩走廊那盞壁燈亮著，我把三扇窗的鎖扳到底。
延伸版：水壺和兩個鍋子後來都沒用到，我隔天把水倒回去的時候，風還在推同一扇窗。

en.content:
The night the sea warning went up, the wind kept knocking at the window frames, and I worked along the wall turning all three window locks as far as they would go.

The power cut out twice, and after that I left on only the wall lamp in the hallway and pushed every other switch down.

Rain fell from eight until midnight with a break of about twenty minutes in the middle, and I used that gap to fill the kettle and two pots.

At daylight the wind was still going, and I stood at the window pulling in the hangers I had left out, a row of drops still hanging off the hook.
en.editorNote: Good for a typhoon night, or the evening before anyone announces whether work is canceled, and for the friend riding it out alone
variations: Short: After the power cut out twice, the hallway wall lamp was the only light left, and I turned all three window locks as far as they would go.
Extended: I never used the kettle or the pots. When I poured the water back the next day, the wind was still pushing on the same window.

items.sourceNote: 豐懿設計室內燈光選擇專文：同樣亮度不同色溫會做出完全不同的空間氛圍、臥室建議暖黃或中性偏暖並與壁燈分開控制；作為室內光線與久雨情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
連著下了九天雨，除濕機的水箱我倒到第九桶，倒完擺回原位再按一次開關。

衣服掛在房裡的伸縮桿上，摸起來還是涼的，我把電風扇對著它們吹了一整夜。

第十天早上出太陽，我把窗全推開，棉被拖到有光的那一塊地板上攤平。

中午雲又壓過來，我在雨落下之前把棉被抱回房間，抱進去的時候它還是熱的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合連日下雨、衣服怎麼都不乾的那幾天分享，也適合傳給那個把除濕機當室友的人
variations: 短版：連著下了九天雨，除濕機的水箱我倒到第九桶，第十天早上出太陽。
延伸版：棉被熱的時間大概撐到晚上八點，我摸了兩次，第二次已經跟房間一樣溫度了。

en.content:
It rained nine days straight, and I emptied the dehumidifier tank for the ninth time, set it back in place, and pressed the switch again.

The laundry hung on the extendable pole in my room still felt cool to the touch, so I aimed the fan at it and left it running all night.

On the tenth morning the sun came out, I pushed every window open and dragged the quilt onto the patch of floor where the light landed.

By noon the clouds moved back in, and I carried the quilt into the bedroom before the rain started, and it was still warm going in.
en.editorNote: Good for a long rainy stretch when nothing will dry, and for anyone whose dehumidifier has become a roommate
variations: Short: Nine days of rain, nine trips to empty the dehumidifier tank, and on the tenth morning the sun came out.
Extended: The quilt held its warmth until about eight that evening. I checked twice, and the second time it was the same temperature as the room.

items.sourceNote: 陳一鳳建築師事務所專文：住家建議採三千K黃光、五千K白光偏冷偏集中適用於辦公與教室、臥室床頭建議暖黃；作為濕冷早晨與室內燈色情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
鋒面過境的清晨十七度，我在門口站了一分半鐘，回頭進去多套一件外套。

機車坐墊上結了一層薄薄的霧氣，我用袖口從左邊擦到右邊，來回擦了兩趟。

整條路的人都把安全帽鏡片壓下來，紅燈的時候，隔壁那台車的排氣管冒著白煙。

進辦公室我把外套掛在壁燈旁邊那根掛勾上，領口摸起來還是濕的，我讓它就掛在那裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合第一波東北季風來的那天分享，也適合傳給同樣是騎車通勤的同事
variations: 短版：清晨十七度，我在門口站了一分半鐘，回頭多套一件外套才出門。
延伸版：那件外套掛到下班都沒乾，我摸了領口，直接穿上去，外面的溫度跟早上一樣。

en.content:
Seventeen degrees the morning the front came through, and I stood in the doorway for a minute and a half before going back in for another jacket.

A thin film of mist had settled on the scooter seat, and I wiped it left to right with my sleeve, twice across.

Everyone on the road had their visors pulled down, and at the red light the car beside me was pushing white smoke out of its tailpipe.

At the office I hung the jacket on the hook beside the wall lamp, the collar still damp under my fingers, and I left it hanging right there.
en.editorNote: Good for the day the first cold front arrives, and for the coworker who also commutes on two wheels
variations: Short: Seventeen degrees at dawn. I stood in the doorway for a minute and a half, then went back in for another jacket.
Extended: The jacket was still damp at the end of the day. I felt the collar, put it on anyway, and outside it was the same temperature as the morning.

items.sourceNote: 中研院研之有物「成年了還得聽爸媽的話？高齡社會下的成人親子衝突解方」葉光輝研究專文：年長父母重視情感連結與陪伴、子女容易把父母行為讀成糾正、共享式策略優於單方退讓；作為成年子女聽錯父母話意情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
媽把布尺攤在餐桌上，說那件襯衫她幫我放寬一點。

我聽成她覺得我這半年變壯了，低頭把自己的手臂在燈下看了兩秒。

她量的位置是袖口那一圈，一邊量一邊講這種棉布洗過會縮。

布尺捲回去以前，她又拉開量了一遍，數字寫在便條紙上，別進襯衫的內袋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家人幫你改衣服的那天分享，也適合傳給那個會把爸媽一句話反覆想很久的人
variations: 短版：媽把布尺攤在餐桌上，說那件襯衫她幫我放寬一點，我先低頭看了自己的手臂。
延伸版：那張便條紙我一直沒動它，換季收衣服的時候摸到，上面的數字比我記得的還小。

en.content:
Mom spread the tape measure out on the dining table and said she'd let out that shirt a little for me.

I took it to mean she thought I'd gotten bigger these past six months, and I looked down at my own arm under the light for two seconds.

The spot she was measuring was the ring around the cuff, and while she measured she talked about how this kind of cotton shrinks in the wash.

Before she rolled the tape measure back up, she opened it and went over it again, wrote the number on a slip of paper, and pinned it inside the shirt.
en.editorNote: Good for the day a family member alters something of yours, and for anyone who replays one sentence from a parent for far too long
variations: Short: Mom spread the tape measure on the dining table and said she'd let out that shirt a little, and I looked down at my own arm first.
Extended: I never moved that slip of paper. I found it again packing clothes away for the season, and the number on it was smaller than I remembered.

items.sourceNote: 大漢家具「家具入宅尺寸怎麼量」專文：搬運路線要逐段量淨寬淨高、最窄點不一定是自家大門、大型家具卡住多半發生在轉向處；作為搬家丈量沙發情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
搬家前一天房東在電話裡說，那組沙發我要留就留。

我聽成他不想再找人來搬，掛掉之後翻出一捲布尺，把沙發從扶手量到另一邊扶手。

他傍晚回撥過來，問我量出來幾公分，新家門框那邊夠不夠寬。

沙發最後停在門口，布尺垂在扶手上晃，我們一人站一邊，各推各的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合搬家那幾天分享，也適合傳給陪你抬過大型家具的那個人
variations: 短版：房東說那組沙發我要留就留，我掛掉電話就去翻布尺。
延伸版：沙發後來進去了，卡住的地方是那面牆的轉角，我們兩個花了四十分鐘才把它轉過去。

en.content:
The day before the move, my landlord said on the phone that I could keep the couch if I wanted it.

I took that to mean he didn't want to line up another hauler, so after hanging up I dug out a tape measure and ran it from one arm of the couch to the other.

He called back that evening and asked what number I'd gotten, and whether the door frame at the new place was wide enough.

The couch ended up parked in the doorway with the tape measure swinging off the arm, the two of us on opposite sides, each pushing our own way.
en.editorNote: Good for moving week, and for whoever once helped you wrestle something too big through a doorway
variations: Short: My landlord said I could keep the couch if I wanted it, and I hung up and went looking for a tape measure.
Extended: The couch did make it in. What caught was the corner by that wall, and it took the two of us forty minutes to swing it around.

items.sourceNote: 104職場力「為什麼主管、同事總是講不聽？」專文：訊息經過不同人的判斷消化會產生認知差異、預設對方應該懂容易造成溝通不良、應反問確認與總結重點；作為交辦話語被聽成期限情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
「這份你先放著，明天再看。」組長經過我座位的時候說了這句。

我聽成明天上午要交，當晚做完，隔天九點放到他桌上。

他說完那句就回自己位子，把手上那份也推到一邊，關了燈才走。

隔天我們兩個都提早到，兩份東西疊在同一張桌子上，誰也沒先開口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被一句交辦話搞到加班的那晚分享，也適合傳給跟你同一組的同事
variations: 短版：組長經過我座位說這份先放著明天再看，我當晚做完，隔天九點放到他桌上。
延伸版：後來我們都沒有再提那個晚上，只是他之後交辦，會多講一句幾號幾點以前給他。

en.content:
"Leave that one for now, look at it tomorrow." That was what my team lead said as he passed my desk.

I heard tomorrow as tomorrow morning, finished it that night, and set it on his desk at nine.

After he said it he went back to his own seat, pushed his own copy off to one side, and turned the lights out on his way out.

The next day we both came in early, the two stacks sitting on the same desk, neither of us the first to speak.
en.editorNote: Good for the night one vague handoff turned into overtime, and for the coworker on your side of it
variations: Short: My team lead passed my desk and said to leave it for now and look at it tomorrow. I finished it that night and set it on his desk at nine.
Extended: Neither of us brought that night up again. He just started adding a date and a time whenever he handed something over.

items.sourceNote: MSBT幔室布緹「窗簾尺寸怎麼量」教學文：先確認最大平面範圍、框內安裝需保留零點五到一公分彈性、寬高要在多個位置各量一次取值；作為租屋處自行丈量窗簾情境的背景參考，內容全為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
窗簾行的老闆娘遞一捲布尺給我，說我自己量比較準。

我聽成她不想再跑一趟，回家踩上椅子，把窗框從上緣量到地板，兩個數字傳給她。

她收到之後打電話來，要我把布尺留著，說掛上去那天還要再量一次。

那捲布尺現在收在窗簾軌道的塑膠袋裡，旁邊是兩顆備用掛勾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合第一次自己弄租屋處窗簾的時候分享，也適合傳給那個剛搬進空房間的朋友
variations: 短版：窗簾行的老闆娘遞一捲布尺給我，說我自己量比較準，我回家就踩上椅子。
延伸版：掛上去那天她真的又量了一次，比我傳的數字多了半公分，她說這半公分是留給洗過之後的。

en.content:
The woman at the curtain shop handed me a roll of tape measure and said I'd get a truer number doing it myself.

I took that to mean she didn't want to make the trip, so I got home, stood on a chair, measured the window frame from the top edge down to the floor, and sent her the two numbers.

She called after they came through and told me to hang on to the tape measure, since we'd be measuring again the day it went up.

That roll of tape measure sits in the plastic bag with the curtain track now, two spare hooks beside it.
en.editorNote: Good for the first time you handle curtains in a rental yourself, and for the friend who just moved into an empty room
variations: Short: The woman at the curtain shop handed me a roll of tape measure and said I'd get a truer number myself, so I got home and stood on a chair.
Extended: She did measure again the day it went up, half a centimeter more than the number I'd sent her, and she said the half centimeter was for after it gets washed.
